Title: Improved chapter matching
Body:
# Added
- Added: Added support for updating volume or chapters markers and the scanner not loosing progress. This requires the parsed marker to stay fixed (Vol. 1 -> Vol. 1 Ch. 1 or Vol 1 Ch 1 -> Ch 1) and no existing marker on disk (ie Ch 1 -> Vol 1 Ch 1 can't have an existing v1c1 on disk)

# Changed
- Changed: Improved logging when no meaningful information could be parsed from a file.
- Changed: Improved logging when a DbUpdateConcurrencyException occurs to help us debug in the future.

# Fixed
- Fixed: Fixed chapters sometimes not being removed correctly after a scan when metadata got updated. (Fixes #4831)
- Fixed: Fixed skipped files (covers) created media issues. (Fixes #4906)
- Fixed: (Kavita+) Fixed chapter count being used for 1 book books. (Fixes #4916)
- Fixed: Fixed Kavita+ metadata sometimes being lost when running metadata mappings.
- Fixed: Fixed an issue where deleting a library would fail due to FK when a chapter had an external review/rating.
